records.title: University of Waterloo International Student Entrance Scholarship

source.raw_extract:
## New! $10,000 International Student Entrance Scholarship

International fee-paying students admitted to full-time, first-year degree studies will receive $10,000 for their first-year studies. No application is required.

#### Do I need to apply for this scholarship?

No, you don't need to apply. Students who are eligible will be automatically granted the scholarship. It will appear on the Awards and financial aid tab in the Waterloo applicant portal starting in mid-April.

#### When will I know if I've been awarded the International Student Entrance Scholarship?

Eligible students will see this appear on the Awards and financial aid tab in the Waterloo applicant portal beginning in April.
source.exact_deadline_wording: No application is required. / No, you don't need to apply.
source.notes: The official scholarship page publishes no application deadline at all for this award; the scholarship is automatic on admission. I therefore did not find any calendar date or rolling/annual statement to record. The record's existing display '~September 20, 2026 (next cycle)' does not appear anywhere on the Waterloo international-scholarships page, and the only 'September 20'-type values on uwaterloo.ca would come from admission or document deadlines for a different process, which the brief forbids using. Recorded as UNKNOWN rather than borrowing an admissions date.

field_mapping.deadline_display: No application is required. (No application deadline published by Waterloo for this automatic award.)

rejected_sources.reason: Fetched and read in full. Contains only undergraduate admission and document deadlines (e.g. 'Programs other than Engineering February 1, 2027 / February 15, 2027', 'Engineering programs (other than Architecture) January 15, 2027 / February 1, 2027') and no 'September 20' value. It is a generic admissions deadline for a different process, so it cannot supply this scholarship's deadline.

source.exact_deadline_wording: The Call will be launched on 15 November and will close on 15 December 2025.
source.notes: The wording mixes a recurring pattern ('15 November') with a hard, year-pinned close ('15 December 2025'). The pinned close is in the past relative to 2026-10-05 while the record is open/upcoming, so outcome is expired_mismatch, no deadline_date is written, and the 15 December figure is NOT generalised into an ANNUAL/recurring value - the AUC has not published a 2027-2028 call, and inventing 2026-12-15 would be exactly the silent roll-forward the brief forbids. The 2026-2027 cycle has closed and the next call is normally announced in mid-November, but that is an assumption and was not written down as a value.

source.raw_extract:
How to Apply, Application Deadlines & Important Dates

Submit your application for the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship here:

Important Dates & Deadlines
- Applications are open year-round.
- Applicants will receive a link to complete ILSC's Online English Placement Test. This test must be completed by the deadline mentioned in the email.
- Successful candidates will be offered the scholarship based on the earliest available date.
source.notes: The provider states an explicitly rolling intake with no published closing date, so semantics are ROLLING with deadline_date null and precision 'rolling'; no calendar date is derived. The only other date ILSC mentions is per-applicant ('the deadline mentioned in the email' for the placement test) and an award timing, not a fixed public deadline. The record's existing rolling description is confirmed by the live page.
